narr: Plenty of deep moisture remained over the El Paso area and a weak upper low was located over Northern Chihuahua with very slow motion which resulted in heavy rain across many of the same areas that got hit hard on June 28th.
ev: Numerous areas of Western El Paso county received flash flooding with numerous roads closed. Some of these areas included Mesa St and Montecillo Blvd, Mesa and Brentwood, Doniphan Rd through Canutillo, Camelia Dr in Westway as well as Executive and Paisano. In addition to these roads, flooding was reported across parts of Interstate 10 with 3 lanes closed near Executive Center.
